Two cities. Real streets.

Drive Spokane and Spokane Valley on imported municipal street centerlines. Roads keep their mapped positions, curves and names. Choose a starting area or explore freely between cities.

This is a driving sandbox: buildings, road widths and trees are illustrative. Elevation, lanes, signals, river geometry and traffic rules are not fully modeled. Mapped roads are not a guarantee of current access or completeness.

Use ▲ to accelerate, ▼ to reverse, ◀ ▶ to steer and BRAKE to stop. Change between chase and overhead views. Road rescue returns your car to the nearest mapped street. Your position saves on this device.
